_doc: AgentWebIndex week 45 (news_2026-45, run Nov 2, 2026). content/w45-tables-regrade.json is a byte-identical copy of the tables.py regrade output from AWI-W45-BASE-RUN-001 (python -m awibench.tables runs OUT.json, exit 0, has_results true). Rerun at agentwebindex regrade_commit it reproduces the file exactly except generated_at. Every number in the Results section #w45 comes from that file; tools/trace_w45.py traces each cell back to it. Never hand-edit either file.
regrade_source: AWI-TINYFISH-001 publish: python -m awibench.tables runs OUT.json at agentwebindex c4556c2944d161e4bf8cbba1f4982b34815bac38 (agentwebindex#52). Against the AWI-W45-BASE-RUN-001 file, only the 2 tinyfish rows and 1 tinyfish freshness_notes entry are new (and generated_at).
live_not_held_note: Providers that are live (not publish_hold) and must be accounted for in week 45: a provider here with no week-45 regrade row gets the copy line '<Name>: not run this week'. Lucille 2 ruling, Nov 2 2026: Keenable is live; AC-4 lifted for Keenable only because it predates Fred's Oct 26 publish approval for Keenable. Whether it ran is never typed here: it is derived from the regrade rows.
extra_rows_note: AWI-TINYFISH-001: TinyFish ran news_2026-45 one day after the Nov 2 run. Its rows (provider tinyfish, run_date 2026-11-03) are shown in the week-45 table with their own Run date. The heading and source dates stay the manifest run_date. Publish hold lifted per Fred, Nov 3 2026 1:59 PM ET (relayed by chief; confirmation pending).
extra_names_note: Display names for extra_rows providers that are not in the vendored data/_upstream/providers.json (data pin 303efdf4 predates tinyfish).
